reference: CH-46E Sea Knight (USMC): side-by-side pilot (right) and co-pilot (left) at a dark-grey steam-gauge panel with a centre console between them, centre cyclics, collectives on each pilot's left; the two T58-GE-16 engines' condition levers sit in the overhead quadrant in the real aircraft (here modelled as two power levers on the left console). NASM CH-46E Sea Knight collection page (airandspace.si.edu, crew/engines), Pima Air & Space CH-46E page, Academy 1/48 HH-46D kit reviews (modelingmadness.com, cybermodeler.com) for the cockpit layout, model's own seat/canopy measurements
